what: the SPEC/04 response cache was AccessDenied on both read and write from M05's IAM scoping until M06. QueryFn's state-table grants were conditioned on dynamodb:LeadingKeys THREAD#* and REVIEW#*; response_cache keys on CACHE#<sha256> in the same table, and CACHE# was not in the enumeration.
why_it_was_silent: response_cache.get and .put treat ANY failure as a miss so a broken cache cannot break a request. The response therefore said cache: 'miss', which is what a working cache says on a first ask. Nothing on the outside distinguished the two.
